qc.label_under_test: On the word right after me or us (often 'as', 'a', 'for', 'of', 'my' or 'our') when a judgement bounces back: an earlier clause has me or us judging another person or group (labelling them, seeing them as something, praising, blaming, thanking, admiring, criticising, rewarding, punishing or forgiving them), and a following clause has that person or group return the same kind of judgement to me or us. Weaker: the same two-way swap between third-person pronouns. Silent: a one-way judgement of me or us with no earlier clause; me or us judged first and then answering back; an ordinary returned action that is not a judgement (visiting, phoning, paying, lending, hugging back); a judgement aimed at a thing rather than a person.

neighbours.label: On the word right after me or us that opens a description of me or us (often 'as', 'a', 'for', 'my' or 'our') when a characterisation bounces back: an earlier clause has me or us characterising another person or group (seeing, regarding, calling or thinking them something, or praising, admiring, criticising, thanking, rewarding or punishing them for something), and the next clause has that person or group characterise me or us in the same way. Weaker: the same two-way swap between third-person pronouns. Silent: a returned attitude with no description of me or us after the pronoun (they trusted us, he feared me); a one-way characterisation of me or us with no earlier clause; me or us characterised first and then answering back; an ordinary returned action (visiting, lending, paying, hugging back); a characterisation aimed at a thing rather than a person.
fire: I always saw Maria as a mentor, and in time she came to see me as one too.
We called the neighbours heroes after the flood, and they called us heroes for organising the shelter.
I praised the coach for her patience, and she praised me for my persistence.
We thanked the volunteers for their hard work, and they thanked us for our support.
I regarded him as a rival for years, and he regarded me as a rival just the same.
We admired the Italian team for their discipline, and they admired us for our speed.
I thought of my landlord as a decent man, and it turned out he thought of me as a decent tenant.
We criticised the other committee for its delays, and it criticised us for our sloppy paperwork.
quiet: I always saw Maria as a mentor, and in time she came to trust me completely.
We called the neighbours heroes after the flood, and they visited us the next morning.
The coach praised me for my persistence during the season.
We thanked the volunteers for their hard work, and they paid us back the loan.
I regarded him as a rival for years, and he feared me the whole time.
We admired the Italian team for their discipline, and they hugged us after the match.
I thought of my old car as a decent machine, and it served me well for a decade.
Our committee was criticised for sloppy paperwork, so we criticised the other committee for its delays.

predictions: Most fire items clear 0.20; the 'trust me completely' and 'paid us back' near misses are the likeliest to leak.
